weakness: No account procedure, approvals, reviews, or monitoring; shared logins on OLTs, EMS, and the voice platform; shared password not changed after a departure
source: P07 (AC-02 objectives); P01 R-005; P03 G-047
remediation_plan: Onboarding and termination checklist covering BSS, suite, voice platform, VPN, EMS, and shared secrets; monthly reconciliation; named network accounts through RADIUS or TACACS+ authentication; remove the voice platform "support" login
milestones: 2026-07-23 shared password changed; 2026-09-30 checklist in use and support login removed; 2026-10-31 first monthly reconciliation; 2026-12-31 named network accounts
resources_required: Office Manager time (1 hour a month); about $1,800 of consultant time (shared with POAM-003)

weakness: Consultant VPN access always on through a shared login; no documented remote access rules
source: P07 (AC-17 objectives); P01 R-020; P04 finding 4
remediation_plan: Named consultant VPN login with MFA, enabled only for scheduled work; remote access rules in POL-02 B.6; new consultant agreement with security and notice terms
milestones: 2026-09-30 named login with MFA; 2026-12-31 consultant agreement signed

weakness: Voice platform portal, router VPN, EMS, and cloud backup console accept a password alone
remediation_plan: Enable MFA on the voice platform portal and the backup console; MFA on the VPN through RADIUS with an authenticator app; EMS reachable only through the VPN
milestones: 2026-09-15 voice platform and backup console MFA; 2026-09-30 VPN MFA
resources_required: About $300 a year for the authentication service

weakness: Shared passwords and the BSS API key in plain text on the hut server; default SNMP read-write string; no change rules
source: P07 test (new finding: default SNMP string); P01 R-005, R-006, R-024
remediation_plan: Password manager for staff and the consultant; delete the text file; remove read-write SNMP and change strings; replace the API key with a provisioning-only key in protected storage
milestones: 2026-09-15 read-write SNMP removed; 2026-09-30 password manager in use and text file deleted; 2026-11-30 new API key

weakness: Customer authentication does not meet 64.2010: phone release without PIN, portal reset with account information, no change notices
remediation_plan: Required PIN for phone release of call detail with mail or call-back fallback; one-time-code reset to the number or email of record; BSS change notices for all 4 change types; assistant guest verification kept off
milestones: 2026-08-14 guest verification off; 2026-10-31 PIN rule and scripts in use; 2026-11-30 portal reset and notices changed by the BSS vendor
resources_required: BSS vendor configuration (included in subscription); representative time

weakness: No CPNI or role-based security training; no training when the AI assistant launched
remediation_plan: One-hour CPNI and customer authentication course at hire and yearly with signed record; network security briefing for technicians and the consultant; update after incidents and system changes
milestones: 2026-10-31 first course for all 7 staff; 2026-12-31 technician briefing

weakness: No audit record review of any system
remediation_plan: Monthly 30-minute review of BSS call detail views and exports, voice platform exports and sign-ins, and VPN logins with a checklist; findings to the Owner and General Manager
resources_required: Office Manager and Network Operations Lead time (30 minutes a month each)

weakness: Configuration backups only in the hut, unencrypted, readable with the shared login; documentation not backed up; first restore needed a fix
source: P07 test; P01 R-007; P04 finding 3
remediation_plan: Encrypted nightly copy of configurations to the cloud backup with 90 days of versions; back up network diagrams, circuit records, and the SSI policies; restore test twice a year
milestones: 2026-10-31 off-site copy; 2026-10-31 documentation backup; 2027-04-30 next restore test

weakness: Staff do not know the 1-hour reporting rule or the outside reporting duties
remediation_plan: Reporting card at every desk and in each truck; 911 outage contacts and the FCC reporting facility in the incident binder; covered in the CPNI course
Monthly advisory review for the router, OLTs, switch, and servers (POL-02 A.9); quarterly external scan by the MSP; remediation time limits
milestones: 2026-09-30 first advisory review; 2026-10-31 first external scan
resources_required: MSP scan (included in contract); Network Operations Lead time

weakness: No security or CPNI terms with the voice platform, consultant, monitoring vendor, or answering service; only the BSS report collected
remediation_plan: Request the voice platform provider's SOC report or questionnaire; CPNI confidentiality and 24-hour incident notice terms at renewal; third-party CPNI access register; annual vendor review
milestones: 2026-10-31 register and voice platform evidence request; 2026-12-31 consultant agreement; 2027-03-31 remaining renewals
resources_required: Office Manager and Owner and General Manager time

weakness: Router firmware 2 years behind with open advisories; OLTs one major release behind; hut servers patched ad hoc; no firmware testing
remediation_plan: Router firmware upgrade in the 2026-09-20 maintenance window after a lab test on the spare; OLT upgrade; monthly hut server patching; 14-day limit for critical fixes
milestones: 2026-09-20 router upgraded; 2026-09-30 OLTs upgraded; 2026-10-31 monthly server patching started

weakness: No access lists or monitoring between the management, server, and subscriber segments
remediation_plan: Separate management segment reachable only from the VPN and the hut console; access lists between segments; login and configuration-change alerts to the monitoring service
resources_required: Consultant time; about $1,700 a year for alerts and log retention
